title: Tesla's World Wireless drawings show wingless craft
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Tesla's World Wireless drawings show wingless craft, about early 20th century at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: His drawings of the world wireless system are full of UFOs.

plain: Jason Jorjani, a researcher and writer, says that the drawings the inventor Nikola Tesla made for his "World Wireless" system, Tesla's plan to send power and messages through the air without wires, are "full of UFOs". In his telling, the drawings show flying craft with no wings. If true, it would hint that Tesla was thinking about, or knew of, craft like the ones people report today.
